newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's Bucaram says to reshuffle cabinet.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Bucaram says to reshuffle cabinet.

text.p: Ecuador's President Abdala Bucaram has said he will change most of his cabinet ministers this Thursday, the day after a planned general strike.
"On February 6, 60 percent of the national cabinet is going to be changed," Bucaram told local television late Sunday. "I can't give any names, but I will have a meeting about this on Monday."

Bucaram said that the new cabinet ministers will "in some cases be independents, in others former politicians and former journalists, and in other cases members of some parties which are currently represented in Congress."
Bucaram is facing a storm of protest over the economic austerity measures he has implemented since coming into power six months ago and unions have a strike planned for Wednesday.

The president has also come under fire for naming friends and relatives to top government posts. Three portfolios in his cabinet are currently vacant, following the resignations of the ministers of tourism, education and labour.
